test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some samosas are burgers.

Some burgers are pizzas.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some samosas are pizzas.

(II): All pizzas are burgers.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d07e4a041d08a2481c7b1331ec5bd6a0c78c7f11f4c8eb49b76c2f6fc4a66c04.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90b472bdb7af95e886a40be75565df629df8ddd31465a88b28b010e20065235b.png] 

Conclusions:

 (I) Some samosas are pizzas → Does not follow (There is no direct relation given between samosas and pizzas. so, it is possible not definite).

(II) All pizzas are burgers → Does not follow (As some burgers are pizzas. so, All pizzas are burger is not true).

Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 4”.
